text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: AUTH_SIGN_VALIDATION - page fired for production (p20). Elevated error rate for token validation across API gateway

pagerduty: Incident 215432 queued -> assigned to oncall-alex (30s)

oncall-alex: acked. looking now. can someone paste a sample failing token + header?

sre-jen: seeing ~12% 401s from /v1/generate and /v1/embed over the last 3m. logs show 'kid not found' from jwt verifier.

oncall-alex: thanks. @sre-jen can you grep jwks cache and jwks fetch logs?

sre-jen: running: `kubectl logs -l app=auth-gw -c verifier --since=5m | grep jwks`

sre-jen: found repeated WARN: "jwks: key fetch failed: 504" and ERROR: "kid mismatch: expected kid \"k_abc123\" got \"k_xyz999\""

sec-mike: that kid mismatch suggests the signing key rotated but the verifier didn't pick up new JWKS entries. are we seeing propagation delays from KMS -> signing service?

support-lina: customer impact: Support queue spiked. ~37 customers reported token failures in last 10m, mostly web clients and mobile SDKs. CS ticket #4478 opened.

oncall-alex: timeline check: any recent deploys to auth-signing-service or jwks-publisher?

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: auth-signing-service v3.4.12 deployed to prod at 2123456670 by ci/cd pipeline (auto). No immediate rollback triggered.

oncall-alex: ok, looks like a rotation happened at deploy time. can we fallback to cached JWKS or pin to previous key while we investigate?

sre-jen: verifier pods have a 2h JWKS refresh TTL, but there's an event showing manual rotation at 2123456625. the fetch path returned 502s for ~90s and then published new jwks order. some verifiers still had old cache causing kid-not-found.

sec-mike: mitigation plan: 1) force JWKS refresh on all verifier instances 2) if still failing, rollback signing-service to prior revision 3) communicate to customers if longer outage expected.

oncall-alex: running a rolling restart on verifier deployment to force reload. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-verifier -n prod`

sre-jen: restart started. monitoring logs.

(2m later)

sre-jen: restarts complete on 5 replicas. JWKS fetch succeeded, no more kid mismatch messages. 401 rate dropping to baseline.

support-lina: Support: incoming messages tapering off. reopened tickets: reduced from 37 -> 6 with user-specific issues.

oncall-alex: great. let's keep monitoring for 30m. leaving pagering open until we confirm stable.

customer-success-raj: prepping a short customer note for affected customers: "We're investigating intermittent auth failures between 21:51-21:55 UTC, root cause was a signing key rotation that wasn't picked up by some verifier instances. We've forced refreshes and are monitoring. No action needed on your side." ok?

sec-mike: small follow-ups: we need to add stricter health check for JWKS endpoint and reduce verifier TTL to 30s for faster propagation. also add alert for repeated kid-mismatch pattern.

oncall-alex: agreed. Jen, can you open an incident follow-up ticket with proposed mitigations and timeline? mark P2 for postmortem.

sre-jen: creating INC-215432-postmortem in tracker and assigning tasks (reduce TTL, add alert, run JWKS chaos test).

pagerduty: Incident 215432 acknowledged by oncall-alex. escalation stopped.

(30m later)

sre-jen: 30m check-in: error rate stable at baseline, no new reports from Support. closing page. will document root cause and remediation steps in the postmortem.

oncall-alex: closing oncall handoff in 10m. @sec-mike please take ownership of follow-ups for key rotation process.

sec-mike: taking ownership. I'll sync with signing-service owners and infra to add stronger propagation guarantees.

support-lina: CS note sent to impacted customers. no escalations.

incident-bot: Incident 215432 resolved by oncall-alex at 2123457050. :white_check_mark:
